pairs: Now on the morning of the Sabbath,
when it began to grow light on the first Sabbath,
venit Maria Magdalene, et altera Maria, videre sepulchrum.
Mary Magdalene and the other Mary went to see the sepulcher.
Et ecce terræmotus factus est magnus.
And behold, a great earthquake occurred.
Angelus enim Domini descendit de cælo:
For an Angel of the Lord descended from heaven,
et accedens revolvit lapidem, et sedebat super eum:
and as he approached, he rolled back the stone and sat down on it.
erat autem aspectus ejus sicut fulgur:
Now his appearance was like lightning,
and his vestment was like snow.
Præ timore autem ejus exterriti sunt custodes,
Then, out of fear of him, the guards were terrified,
and they became like dead men.
Then the Angel responded by saying to the women:
scio enim, quod Jesum, qui crucifixus est,
For I know that you are seeking Jesus,
et videte locum ubi positus erat Dominus.
and see the place where the Lord was placed.
and tell his disciples that he has risen.
et ecce præcedit vos in Galilæam:
And behold, he will precede you to Galilee.
Lo, I have told you beforehand.”
Et exierunt cito de monumento cum timore
And they went out of the tomb quickly,
with fear and in great joy,
running to announce it to his disciples.
But they drew near and took hold of his feet,
nuntiate fratribus meis ut eant in Galilæam;
announce it to my brothers, so that they may go to Galilee.
ecce quidam de custodibus venerunt in civitatem,
behold, some of the guards went into the city,
et nuntiaverunt principibus sacerdotum omnia quæ facta fuerant.
and they reported to the leaders of the priests all that had happened.
Et congregati cum senioribus consilio accepto,
And gathering together with the elders, having taken counsel,
they gave an abundant sum of money to the soldiers,
Dicite quia discipuli ejus nocte venerunt,
“Say that his disciples arrived at night
Et si hoc auditum fuerit a præside,
And if the procurator hears about this,
they did as they were instructed.
Et divulgatum est verbum istud apud Judæos,
And this word has been spread among the Jews,
Undecim autem discipuli abierunt in Galilæam in montem ubi constituerat illis Jesus.
Now the eleven disciples went on to Galilee, to the mountain where Jesus had appointed them.
And, seeing him, they worshipped him,
Et accedens Jesus locutus est eis,
And Jesus, drawing near, spoke to them,
Data est mihi omnis potestas in cælo et in terra:
“All authority has been given to me in heaven and on earth.
Therefore, go forth and teach all nations,
baptizantes eos in nomine Patris, et Filii, et Spiritus Sancti:
baptizing them in the name of the Father and of the Son and of the Holy Spirit,
docentes eos servare omnia quæcumque mandavi vobis:
teaching them to observe all that I have ever commanded you.
et ecce ego vobiscum sum omnibus diebus,
And behold, I am with you always,
even to the consummation of the age.”
